mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS user_name, d.name AS dept_name, l.loan_no, v.voucher_no FROM fin_expense_claim c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = c.dept_id LEFT JOIN fin_loan l ON l.id = c.loan_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = c.voucher_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, a.code AS account_code, a.name AS account_name FROM fin_expense_claim_item i JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = i.account_id WHERE i.claim_id = #{claimId} ORDER BY i.id
